current_target.input: 2 camera-major views x 256 patches; normalized proprio(8); continuous 8x7 action chunk
current_target.packing: Original positions preserved; language/proprio/action tokens protected; OFT fork SDPA

global_rules: Keep author-native and matched-CTI experiments in separate method IDs, dependency locks, configs and results. No paper metric is a reproduced result.
Debug only on frozen development states. Native all-50-per-task evaluation overlaps our final states and must not be run during development.

Both native loaders update_auto_map and copy modeling code into checkpoint directories. Use isolated metadata/code overlays with immutable weight files; never invoke these helpers on the shared checkpoint.

Pin transitive Git dependencies, simulator and preprocessing. Measure full observation-to-action wall latency including selection/history/extra policy calls; preserve native CUDA-only timing separately.

baselines.name: VLA-ACL

license.weight_card: No license field in inspected HF metadata; record separately from code license.

native_contract.base: Fine-tuned OpenVLA-OFT, continuous L1 action head; diffusion pruning explicitly unsupported
native_contract.scorer_input: Raw fused vision-backbone patches BEFORE LLM projection; no explicit language/proprio scorer input with default use_film=False
native_contract.scorer: 5-layer bidirectional Transformer, hidden1024, heads16, dropout0; independently sorted top-K per view; released K32/K64 means64/128 total
native_contract.gradient: Only scorer weights train; student gradients traverse frozen projector/LLM/action head. Features and teacher are no_grad. LLM gradient checkpointing is used.
native_contract.soft_gate: LapSum soft top-K; s*X+sqrt(1-s^2)*black-image features, black coefficient detached
native_contract.loss: 0.5 normalized action L1 to demonstration +0.5 L1 to full-context teacher
native_contract.attention: OFT bidirectional action-decoding fork required; scorer does not require attention maps. Inference preserves original visual/tail positions.

dependencies.setup_note: Install inspected ACL subtree in an isolated environment; SETUP's generic upstream clone would omit ACL changes.

compatibility_obstacles: CTI caches projected LLM tokens; released ACL scorer expects pre-projection features. Expose both from one vision pass and validate native indices/positions.
CTI detached/no_grad teacher wrapper cannot train ACL's soft student. A separate differentiable frozen-policy adapter must prove scorer gradients and no base-weight gradients.

Author RLDS loader uses dataset split=train, covering our validation/test episodes. Released scorer training membership is unrecorded. Strict matched comparison must retrain on our train302 manifest; released weights are author-native only.

Native visual-only5x1024 scorer, feature space and gates differ from CTI conditions/capacity. Keep native row; define matched supervision ablation with identical conditions, capacity, data, budgets and packing.
Demonstration supervision requires normalized8-step action chunks with faithful endpoint padding/masks. The90/12 diagnostic panels are not an ACL training dataset.
minimum_reproduction_steps: Freeze source/transitive dependencies in separate server environment; create read-only-weight metadata overlay.
Download only pinned SpatialK32/K64 scorer on server, verify sizes/SHA256, and record unknown episode-level training membership.
On registered train observations verify dense parity, native raw-feature scorer, per-camera top-K and original positions.
Run native inference only on frozen development states with its horizon/open-loop and full timing explicitly recorded.
For matched supervision implement differentiable adapter and manifest-filtered chunks; freeze train budget/seeds, retrain train302, and evaluate through common runtime.

baselines.name: SpecPrune-VLA
baselines.official_link_verified: PMLR Software link resolves to the inspected repository

license.embedded_oft: MIT: openvla-oft/LICENSE; preserve inherited attribution and file headers
license.root: README advertises MIT but root LICENSE target is absent; inspected runtime is inside licensed openvla-oft subtree

native_contract.attention: Decoder unconditionally constructs manual LlamaAttention and returns maps; attn_implementation alone cannot switch it to CTI's SDPA path
native_contract.mechanism: Early frame-change/local attention pruning; prior-query important-token reuse; layer-wise pruning; motion-sensitive profile and action requery controller

dependencies.transformers: Unpinned OFT Git fork plus local modified modeling_llama.py
dependencies.missing_declaration: spec_prune_vla imports skimage.util but scikit-image is not listed in subtree pyproject dependencies

compatibility_obstacles: Scheduler: run_libero_eval.py:7 overwrites CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4. Replace in a recorded isolated launcher adapter before any GPU execution.

Interface: pruning is inside LLM layers and consumes prior frames/actions/attention. A one-time input gather cannot implement it; use separate runtime with history reset per trial and original IDs throughout layers.

Controller: default action_adapter=True consumes actions/increments t without env.step for acting_steps<10 (run_libero_eval.py:436). Later precise-mode changes may clear queued actions. Resolve warm-start accounting before claiming reproduction; separate native requery from matched fixed8-step execution.
Prompt: historical vlm_layer_attn hardcodes text start513 and length34. Validate variable prompt/proprio/action boundaries; any corrected masks must be a versioned adapter.

Compute: per-layer retention, manual attention, frame similarity, history extraction and adaptive query count cannot be represented by a single finalK. Log layer token counts and actual queries; separate native and matched-budget curves.
Timing: native CUDA event excludes initial image/frame-similarity processing and subsequent attention-to-history extraction. It is not full observation-to-action latency.
Implementation review: first dynamic prune layer10 precedes first importance update14; scores start at zero. Validate intended tie behavior and dense-disabled parity before using this schedule.
minimum_reproduction_steps: Freeze isolated source/dependencies, add skimage, preserve read-only weights through metadata overlay, and remove GPU4 override in recorded launcher adapter.
Test controller warm-start/env.step counts, prompt/proprio/action ranges, per-episode history reset and dense-disabled action parity; keep patch list explicit.
Run native full mechanism on development states with author ratios/schedule; record actual simulator steps, query counts, per-layer tokens and full wall latency.
For matched protocol freeze common horizon/states/preprocessing/action execution while retaining temporal/layer pruning; label controller/attention changes as variants.
Choose budget mapping using development measurements and freeze before final tests. Never call a single attention-topK replacement SpecPrune-VLA.

baselines.name: Action-JND
baselines.source_availability: Official arXiv abstract/full text plus exact-title/Action-JND/arXiv-ID GitHub searches identified no author-linked Action-JND implementation/checkpoint on audit date. This is not proof none exists.
baselines.paper_contract: OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT; OFT primary/wrist views and continuous chunks, with separate per-view JND estimators. Code-level proprio/packing/attention compatibility unverified.
baselines.not_substituted: Author ruizhao26/FeatJND repository is a different deep-feature JND paper, not Action-JND VLA reproduction.
minimum_reproduction_steps: Obtain author-linked source/checkpoint; pin license, commit and training provenance.
Audit per-view estimator, action discrepancy, perturbation objective, pruning versus KV reuse, and action-chunk interface.
Run parity and development validation before matched comparison; otherwise explicitly report unavailable reproduction instead of paper metrics.
